Title: Generally Available: Azure IoT Edge now supports new version releases of Ubuntu Server, Debian, and Yocto

Body.Content: Azure IoT Edge’s supported platforms now include Ubuntu Server 24.04, Debian 12, and Yocto Scarthgap. For more details on processor architectures supported, see supported platforms. Official installation packages for the latest IoT Edge releases are now available from Microsoft's package repository.
